title: Filtered descent for normalized pages without finiteness
statement: Let $C$ be an abelian category [def-sp-abelian]. Let $(K,F)$ and $(K\prime,F\prime)$ be integer cochain complexes with decreasing filtrations by subcomplexes [def-sp-filtration, def-sp-filtered-complex-subquotients]. Let $E,E\prime$ be cohomological spectral sequences starting at page one [def-sp-spectral-sequence]. For every $r\ge1$ supply representative differential data $D_r,D\prime_r$ on their actual cycle/boundary cokernels [lem-sp-filtered-complex-page-differential], and complex isomorphisms $j_r:E_r\cong D_r.page$, $j\prime_r:E\prime_r\cong D\prime_r.page$. Assume that transporting the successor homology isomorphisms through these complex isomorphisms gives normalized comparisons on successor cycles [lem-sp-filtered-complex-normalized-homology]. Any chain map $b:K\to K\prime$ restricting to every filtration step induces a spectral-sequence morphism $N:E\to E\prime$ such that, for every test object $A$, bidegree $(q,p)$, $r\ge1$, step representatives $x,y$ and graded cycles $z,z\prime$, the equations $x\iota_F b=y\iota_{F\prime}$, $z\iota_Z=x\pi_F$ and $z\prime\iota_{Z\prime}=y\pi_{F\prime}$ imply $z\pi_rj_r^{-1}N_r=z\prime\pi\prime_r(j\prime_r)^{-1}$. This requires no boundedness or finiteness of either filtration.

proof.text: Use the proved generic private declarations quotientPageSquares and quotientPageMap of FilteredQuotientPageMaps: their signatures take arbitrary FilteredObject complexes and contain no IsFinite hypothesis. These restrict a filtered map to steps, descend to graded pieces, restrict to cycles and descend through boundary cokernels. The representative differential equation on an epic cover proves the chain-map equation. The finite-filtration public theorem filteredQuotient_page_maps is not invoked.

Compare the step restrictions at r and r+1 by cancelling monic step inclusions. Compare the graded maps by cancelling the graded cokernel projection. Cancel the graded cycle inclusion to obtain compatibility of the successor-cycle restrictions with their inclusions in r-cycles.

Take the epic successor-cycle covers. Cancel the target page cycle inclusion to relate the successor restriction to the cycles map of the quotient-page map. Precompose homology naturality with the epic cover followed by homology projection; normalization on successor representatives and the quotient projection square give the same composites.

Conjugate quotient-page maps by j and jprime. Apply functoriality of homology to the preceding square, and cancel the homology images and component maps of the inverse isomorphisms. This defines the spectral-sequence morphism.

For arbitrary representatives, cancel the target step inclusion to identify y with x followed by the canonical restriction. Cancel the graded cycle inclusion to identify zprime with z followed by the canonical cycle map. The boundary cokernel square and inverse-isomorphism identities prove the desired representative equation.

theorem exists_filteredCanonical_page_descent
    (K K' : CochainComplex C ℤ) (F : DecreasingFiltration K) (F' : DecreasingFiltration K')
    (E E' : CohomologicalSpectralSequence C 1)
    (D : ∀ (r : ℤ) (_hr : 1 ≤ r), FilteredComplexPageDifferential K F r)
    (D' : ∀ (r : ℤ) (_hr : 1 ≤ r), FilteredComplexPageDifferential K' F' r)
    (j : ∀ (r : ℤ) (hr : 1 ≤ r), E.page r hr ≅ (D r hr).page)
    (j' : ∀ (r : ℤ) (hr : 1 ≤ r), E'.page r hr ≅ (D' r hr).page)
    (hj : ∀ (r : ℤ) (hr : 1 ≤ r) (pq : ℤ × ℤ),
      FilteredComplexHomologyNormalized K F r (D r hr) pq
        ((HomologicalComplex.homologyFunctor C (ComplexShape.up' (r, 1 - r)) pq).mapIso
          (j r hr).symm ≪≫ E.iso r (r + 1) pq rfl hr ≪≫
          (HomologicalComplex.eval C (ComplexShape.up' (r + 1, 1 - (r + 1))) pq).mapIso
            (j (r + 1) (by omega))))
    (hj' : ∀ (r : ℤ) (hr : 1 ≤ r) (pq : ℤ × ℤ),
      FilteredComplexHomologyNormalized K' F' r (D' r hr) pq
        ((HomologicalComplex.homologyFunctor C (ComplexShape.up' (r, 1 - r)) pq).mapIso
          (j' r hr).symm ≪≫ E'.iso r (r + 1) pq rfl hr ≪≫
          (HomologicalComplex.eval C (ComplexShape.up' (r + 1, 1 - (r + 1))) pq).mapIso
            (j' (r + 1) (by omega))))
    (b : K ⟶ K')
    (hb : ∀ q : ℤ, ∃ s : (F.step q : CochainComplex C ℤ) ⟶
        (F'.step q : CochainComplex C ℤ), s ≫ (F'.step q).arrow = (F.step q).arrow ≫ b) :
    ∃ N : E ⟶ E',
      ∀ (A : C) (q p r : ℤ) (hr : 1 ≤ r)
        (x : A ⟶ (F.step q : CochainComplex C ℤ).X (q + p))
        (y : A ⟶ (F'.step q : CochainComplex C ℤ).X (q + p))
        (z : A ⟶ (F.complexCycles q (q + p) r : C))
        (z' : A ⟶ (F'.complexCycles q (q + p) r : C)),
        x ≫ (F.step q).arrow.f (q + p) ≫ b.f (q + p) =
          y ≫ (F'.step q).arrow.f (q + p) →
        z ≫ (F.complexCycles q (q + p) r).arrow =
          x ≫ (F.complexQuotientπ q (q + 1) (by omega)).f (q + p) →
        z' ≫ (F'.complexCycles q (q + p) r).arrow =
          y ≫ (F'.complexQuotientπ q (q + 1) (by omega)).f (q + p) →
        z ≫ filteredComplexPageπ K F r (q, p) ≫ (j r hr).inv.f (q, p) ≫
          (N.hom r hr).f (q, p) =
        z' ≫ filteredComplexPageπ K' F' r (q, p) ≫ (j' r hr).inv.f (q, p)
